files.description: Daily weather at one station (90 rows, one per day in date order from 2025-06-01, no gaps): date (YYYY-MM-DD), temp_c (mean temperature in degrees C, two decimals; about 1% empty), humidity (percent, whole number).

task_text: The standard error of the mean of a window is the sample standard deviation of its values (dividing by n - 1) divided by the square root of n, the number of values in the window. For each day, give the standard error of the mean humidity over a 10-day window (that day and the 9 days before it); leave it empty for the first 9 days. `result` should be a Series indexed by date.
intended_computation: For each day from the 10th on: sample sd of the 10 humidity values in the trailing window / sqrt(10).

predicted_direction.reason: rolling().sem() used sqrt(n - 1) on 2.x; 3.x uses sqrt(n), the definition given in the task.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row X01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
